config.script:
from java.io import ByteArrayOutputStream
	from org.apache.poi.xssf.usermodel import XSSFWorkbook, XSSFCellStyle
	from org.apache.poi.ss.util import CellRangeAddress
	from org.apache.poi.ss.usermodel import *
	import system
	
	# Get your data
	data = system.db.runNamedQuery('KPI/DowntimeSchedule/Get_PlannedScheduleType')
	typeList = data.getColumnAsList(0)
	
	# Create workbook
	wb = XSSFWorkbook()
	ws = wb.createSheet("Downtime Schedule")
	
	# Headers
	headers = ["Line", "Planned", "B", "C", "A"]
	headerRow = ws.createRow(0)
	headerStyle = wb.createCellStyle()
	headerFont = wb.createFont()
	headerFont.setBold(True)
	headerStyle.setFont(headerFont)
	headerStyle.setAlignment(HorizontalAlignment.CENTER)
	headerStyle.setVerticalAlignment(VerticalAlignment.CENTER)
	
	for col, header in enumerate(headers):
	    cell = headerRow.createCell(col)
	    cell.setCellValue(header)
	    cell.setCellStyle(headerStyle)
	
	# Build data with LINE headers
	currentRow = 1
	for line in range(1, 9):  # Lines 1-8
	    
	    # Add LINE header row (merged A:E)
	    headerRow = ws.createRow(currentRow)
	    ws.addMergedRegion(CellRangeAddress(currentRow, currentRow, 0, 4))
	    
	    lineCell = headerRow.createCell(0)
	    lineCell.setCellValue("LINE " + str(line))
	    
	    # Style for LINE header
	    lineStyle = wb.createCellStyle()
	    lineFont = wb.createFont()
	    lineFont.setBold(True)
	    lineFont.setFontHeightInPoints(14)
	    lineStyle.setFont(lineFont)
	    lineStyle.setAlignment(HorizontalAlignment.CENTER)
	    lineStyle.setVerticalAlignment(VerticalAlignment.CENTER)
	    lineStyle.setFillForegroundColor(IndexedColors.LIGHT_BLUE.index)
	    lineStyle.setFillPattern(FillPatternType.SOLID_FOREGROUND)
	    lineCell.setCellStyle(lineStyle)
	    
	    currentRow += 1
	    
	    # Add planned downtime rows for this line
	    for pType in typeList:
	        dataRow = ws.createRow(currentRow)
	        dataRow.createCell(0).setCellValue(line)
	        dataRow.createCell(1).setCellValue(pType)
	        dataRow.createCell(2).setCellValue(0)
	        dataRow.createCell(3).setCellValue(0)
	        dataRow.createCell(4).setCellValue(0)
	        currentRow += 1
	    
	    # Blank separator row
	    blankRow = ws.createRow(currentRow)
	    currentRow += 1
	
	# Auto-size columns
	for col in range(len(headers)):
	    ws.autoSizeColumn(col)
	
	# Save to bytes
	outputStream = ByteArrayOutputStream()
	wb.write(outputStream)
	excelBytes = outputStream.toByteArray()
	outputStream.close()
	wb.close()
	
	# Download
	fileName = system.date.format(system.date.now(), 'YYYYMMdd') + '_DowntimeScheduleTemplate.xlsx'
	system.perspective.download(fileName, excelBytes)
